name: fqc-github
description: GitHub access for FQC-ARR wrapping the gh CLI. Reads (PR status, checks) are silent; branch create is low-risk; push + open-PR carry destructiveHint so Sana raises an approval card. Never targets qa/prod branches.

securityScheme.note: Sana holds the GitHub app/OAuth token and mirrors the invoking user. Fallback local: gh auth session.

tools.name: get_pr
tools.description: Read PR metadata (title, body, state, mergeable, reviews). Read-only.

tools.name: pr_checks
tools.description: Read CI check runs / statuses for a PR (for ci-monitor polling). Read-only.

tools.name: create_branch
tools.description: Create a feature branch from the default branch. Must match feature/EDAEM-*; never qa/prod.

tools.name: push_branch
tools.description: Push local commits on the feature branch to origin. GATED (destructiveHint).

tools.name: create_pr
tools.description: Open a PR from the feature branch into the default branch. GATED (destructiveHint). Title/body identifier-first, no agent signature.
